name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge, get 3 recipes.
problem: People often do not know what recipes they can make with the random ingredients already inside their fridge.
audience: Everyday home cooks looking to make meals from ingredients they already have on hand.

features.name: Fridge Photo Ingredient Detection
features.description: Users take a photo of their open fridge using the camera to automatically detect available ingredients.

features.name: Recipe Suggestions
features.description: Presents three recipes ranked by how many of the detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Shopping List Generation
features.description: Generates a shopping list for the missing ingredients needed to complete suggested recipes.
